READ ME! 👀🦭 So do seals feel pain the same way we do, short answer is basically yes, you know they're mammals just like us, so they have a very similar nervous system and the same kind of pain receptors, and when a seal gets hurt the signals go to the brain pretty much the way ours do, that's why vets give injured seals pain meds at rescue centers, trust me BUT! we can't know exactly how it feels for them, and animals are really good at hiding pain in the wild, so a seal that looks fine might not be, and the thick blubber doesn't make them tough in that way if you ever see a seal on the beach, just give it space and call your local marine rescue instead of touching it The more you know! 🦭 #sealfacts #seals #cuteseals #animalfacts #sealsofinstagram [do seals feel pain, seal facts, seal biology, marine mammals, seal rescue, cute seals, animals, niko the seal]
